deploybot: Rollback initiated for release tag rwin-2026-03-20-a on prod-usw due to elevated error rate. initiating switchback to rwin-2026-03-19-b and pinning.
anya: Ack. Observability — any idea scope? frontend or runtime?
mike: Seeing ~12% 5xx on /v1/generate and token latency jump from 80ms -> 420ms on prod-usw. Correlates with canary at ~10:40 UTC.
liz: Can we get the deploy tag and commit sha for the revert? Need to update the release notes and customer-facing channel.
deploybot: revert command queued by @mike: deploy revert --env prod-usw --from rwin-2026-03-19-b --tag rwin-2026-03-20-a --reason "5xx+latency spike"
deploybot: metadata: commit: a7c3b9f2, prev_commit: 6f2d1e8b, pipeline: ci/release/2026. timestamp: 2026-03-20T10:42:10Z
mike: filing a quick postmortem placeholder. @oncall-bot can you create an incident for tracking and paging?
oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260320-042 created, severity: high. Pager rotation: oncall-sre. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-20260320-042
liz: Copy. I'll draft a short rollback note for #announcements after we confirm traffic back to rwin-2026-03-19-b.
deploybot: Revert deploy in progress — steps: 1) drain canary 2) switch traffic to previous tag 3) verify health checks 4) unpin new tag. ETA ~3–6m. Logs:
```
[10:43:02] draining canary pods
[10:43:28] applying traffic switch to rwin-2026-03-19-b
[10:44:05] running health checks (3/3)
```
mike: Nice. Watching metrics now.
deploybot: Rollback complete. Traffic 100% -> rwin-2026-03-19-b. New tag rwin-2026-03-20-a reverted and write-protected (pinned-back). commit a7c3b9f2 marked for follow-up. Validation: 5xx down to baseline, p50 token latency ~90ms.
liz: Confirmed. I'll post the announcement: "We reverted today's deploy to restore performance; follow-up investigation ongoing". Any block on re-trying a fixset? 
anya: Hold on additional rollforward until root cause triaged. +1 on following up with perf trace.
mike: I'll grab traces and attach to the incident. thanks team :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260320-042 updated: status -> investigating. Assignee: mike.sre
deploybot: All done. If anyone needs the exact revert commands or audit log, ping me and I'll paste the runbook entries."
